Not all commutes are created equal, and tackling a hard commute takes a lot more than a motor and a set of wheels. Ausom knows this better than most, with six highly capable, long-range electric scooters designed to handle your toughest trips. And this Black Friday, you can get the right tool for the job at the lowest prices of the year.
There’s a difference between owning an electric scooter you haul out the farmer’s market every few months and actually riding one every day. If you’re just covering the occasional trip around the neighborhood, almost anything with two wheels and a battery will probably do. But if you’re depending on your scooter to handle a hard commute climbing hills, navigating broken pavement, and covering serious distances ever day, the right equipment matters – and Ausom has the right equipment for just about any ride.
From November 16-December 1, Ausom’s has the right equipment making that decision a little easier this Black Friday, with its entire electric scooter lineup hitting its lowest prices of 2026 and additional savings available exclusively to Electrek readers when they use the code ElectrekFB at checkout.
Before diving into the individual e-scooter breakdowns, let’s first take a look at the flash sale deals available throughout the event. These limited-stock offers will run from 9 p.m. to 10 p.m. EST and cannot be combined with the exclusive discount code or any free gifts.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
From November 16 to 26, 2026, you can score the L2 Max Dual Motor Electric Scooter down at $779 shipped , rather than $799, and the Gosoul 2 Pro Dual Motor Electric Scooter for just $769 , with one selected daily to receive the flash savings.
From November 27 to December 1, 2026, the list of e-scooter models included will be expanded.
With six different models on offer this shopping season, Ausom has the right ride for just about every kind of rider, from everyday campus commuters looking for dependable transportation between bells to high-strung adrenaline junkies ready to push the limits of tiny, two-wheeled performance. Here’s the rundown :
Ausom Gosoul 2
Gosoul 2.
Built for real-world roads, the Gosoul 2 offers smooth, quiet, and confident travel across city streets, wet roads, and light gravel with puncture-resistant 10×2.5″ tubeless tires that reduce the risk of flats, enhance grip, and reduce maintenance needs for everyday dependability. E-ABS brakes cut motor power for faster responses and shorter stopping distances with superior control, while the powerful, 1100W motor, 70 km (~44 miles) of range, and ability to haul riders up 20% grade hills make the Gosoul 2 a great choice for any tech-savvy commuter.
Regularly priced at $729, the Gosoul 2 is on sale this month for just $569, and $549 for Electrek readers .
Ausom L2 Max Dual Motor
L2 Max Dual Motor.
For riders who want something more than basic transportation, the L2 Max Dual Motor brings serious performance to city streets, hills and gravel rides. Its dual 1,000W brushless motors deliver up to 2,688W of peak power, giving riders the extra muscle to accelerate confidently, climb steep neighborhood hills and keep moving when the pavement ends. A nearly 1 kWh battery provides up to 90 km (~56 miles) of range, making longer commutes and multiple stops around town easier to manage between charges. The 10×3″ puncture-resistant tubeless tires help maintain traction while reducing the risk of flats, and an adjustable dual swingarm suspension smooths out potholes, cracked pavement and rough gravel. With a top speed of 38 mph and the ability to tackle grades up to 34%, the L2 Max has plenty of performance in reserve for hard commutes and demanding rides, while its front and rear disc brakes with E-ABS help bring that power under control when traffic (or wildlife) demands a quick stop.
Regularly priced at $1,049, the L2 Max Dual Motor is on sale this month for $809, and $799 for Electrek readers .
Ausom DT2 Pro
DT2 Pro
Built for riders who refuse to choose between range and performance, the DT2 Pro packs dual 1,100W motors producing more than 2,900W of peak power. That’s enough muscle to tackle steep hills and grades of up to 36%, even when the route gets challenging, while its nearly 40 mph top speed gives riders plenty of acceleration for open stretches. The DT2’s 1.22 kWh battery delivers up to 115 km (~71 miles) of claimed range, making it a strong option for longer commutes or riders who want to cover several trips without stopping to recharge. Its 10×3″ puncture-resistant tires provide a wider contact patch for added traction, while an adjustable suspension front and rear helps absorb bumps, cracks, and rough patches to keep the rider stable and comfortable across changing terrain.
Regularly priced at $1,349, the DT2 Pro is on sale this month for $1,069, and $1,059 for Electrek readers .
Gosoul 2 Pro Dual Motor
Gosoul 2 Pro Dual Motor.
Taking the Gosoul 2 to the next level, the Gosoul 2 Pro Dual Motor packs a pair of 1,400W motors for a 36 mph top speed and the ability to tackle grades of up to 33%. An 864 Wh battery provides up to 90 km (~56 miles) of range, while the Ausom ShocFree dual swingarm suspension and 10×2.75″ tubeless tires help keep things smooth and stable on all kinds of roads and paths.
Regularly priced at $999, the Gosoul 2 Pro Dual Motor is on sale for $829, and $799 for Electrek readers .
K20 Pro Dual Motor
The K20 Pro Dual Motor packs plenty of performance into a more approachable package, with dual 1,400W motors delivering 2,800W of peak power – more than enough to give riders the go-power they need to carve up modern day traffic and tackle grades of up to 33%, while its 36 mph top speed leaves plenty of headroom for open stretches. Its 864 Wh battery provides up to 90 km (~56 miles) of claimed range, making it a practical option for hard commutes or a full day of riding around town. ShocFree suspension and 10×2.75″ tubeless tires help smooth out potholes, uneven pavement and light off-road sections, while front and rear disc brakes with E-ABS provide maximum control during emergency stops.
Regularly priced at $879, the K20 Pro Dual Motor is on sale for just $689, and Electrek readers can do even better at $679 .
Ausom F1 Max
Ausom F1 Max.
Just like it says on the tin, the F1 Max offers maximum performance inspired by the pinnacle of motorsport. Built for riders who want their electric scooter to be considerably more than a commuter, this one delivers up to 3,840W of peak power, pushing the F1 Max to speeds of up to 45 mph and allowing it to tackle grades as steep as 38%. A 1.25 kWh battery pack gives riders 100 km (~62 miles) of range, while an adjustable dual-swingarm suspension and 10×3″ tubeless tires give the scooter the hardware to handle everything from broken city pavement and gravel to light off-road trails. Hydraulic disc brakes with E-ABS help bring all that performance back under control, while a 330 lb. maximum load and wide deck make the F1 Max a substantial machine for bigger, bolder riders ready for longer trips into the wilderness and anyone looking for a little LOT more excitement from their electric scooter.
Regularly priced at $1,549, the Ausom F1 Max is available at the awesome price of just $1,429 for Electrek readers with code ElectrekFB .
Ausom isn’t done yet. They’re sweetening the deal for Electrek readers by throwing in a free gift with every scooter purchase. Buy any Ausom electric scooter between November 16th and 26th and you’ll get a free branded water bottle . From November 27th through December 1st, that gift switches to a branded water bottle carrier , giving late-season shoppers one more reason to take advantage of the best prices of the year.
